name: Data Center Coalition
summary: Data Center Coalition appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First. Argued in Part 13 (The load pays its way).

mentions.excerpt: The Data Center Coalition noted on March 16 that PJM had proposed June 1, 2029, as the date its new transmission services for co-located loads take effect; until then, the market price is the bill.
